blocks.text: South Korean singer-actor Park Ji-hoon officially claimed the Best New Actor trophy at the 47th Blue Dragon Film Awards on Thursday night, November 26, 2026. The prestigious ceremony took place at KBS Hall in Yeouido, Seoul. Industry veterans and rising stars gathered to celebrate the best of Korean cinema over the past year.
